description: The AWS Config recorder exists and is actively recording

matrix_rows.gap: By design, the recorder records a declared list of resource types, not all supported types: Config bills per item recorded and the environment is rebuilt often (DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-05). That the live recorder matches the declared list is shown by svc-acm-ops-aws-no-drift, not here. Only us-east-1 is in scope.
